name: paint/zoom-in-twice
description: Open Paint and click its zoom-in button twice.
source_task: Open Paint and click its zoom-in button twice (do not use keyboard shortcuts). This is an unattended test. Do not wait for a person. Decide yourself. Never buy, send, submit, save or delete anything. Leave the application window open when you are done.
note: hidden: it got stuck on its first run and no fix was saved

steps.note: Zoom level shown before any click, so each click can be proven by the level changing.
First zoom-in click, using the on-screen button rather than a keyboard shortcut.
Second zoom-in click. Paint stays open and nothing is saved.
